task: Add §8 "The two failed reviews (history, DEC-752)" to `docs/changes/W2-50-CIT-E.md` and commit it on its own, with no code or test changes.
status: DONE. The section is committed as `d5abd786` and the working tree is clean.
work_completed: I ran the standing checks first and every one matched the brief: `GOV_ROLE`=engineer, `GOV_TICKET`=DAEO-kl5e, top level `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-50`, branch `w2/W2-50`, head `6d5ad6d0`, status empty. Then I read the CIT-E in full, the two draft fail records in `.gov-runtime/scratch/lead/probes/` (I left them unchanged and did not commit them) and `git log 74403441^..HEAD`. I added §8 at the end of the CIT-E. It has a short opening paragraph, then one block per review: the full probed commit id, the reviewer session, the judgement "fail", and a table of each finding with what was done about it. Review 1 has 8 rows and Review 2 has 3. The section closes with one line: the records stay uncommitted drafts under DEC-752 item 2, a further independent review follows, and only its pass record will go under `docs/probes/DAEO-kl5e/`. Frontmatter: I added `DEC-752` to the end of `decisions_carried`. The schema (`change-execution-record.schema.json` with `common.schema.json`) puts no rule on `decisions_carried` and allows extra properties, so it accepts the id. I validated the edited frontmatter with jsonschema 4.10.3 (Draft 2020-12) and it passed. Nothing else in the file changed.
files_changed: docs/changes/W2-50-CIT-E.md
evidence: Commit `d5abd7867fc8e286aef512de1b1939901ce7a4ce`, "W2-50 (DAEO-kl5e): the CIT-E's history of the two failed reviews (DEC-752)". Trailers: `Task: DAEO-kl5e`, `Role: engineer`, `Implements: DEC-728`, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. `git log --oneline -2` shows `d5abd786` on top of `6d5ad6d0`. `git show --stat HEAD`: 1 file, 42 insertions, 1 deletion. The one deletion is the replaced `decisions_carried` line, so 41 lines were added for §8. `git status --short` is empty after the commit. The hooks folder `/home/usain/Dynamic-Agentic-Engineering-OS/.git/hooks` holds only `*.sample` files and no `pre-commit`. `gov.__file__`: `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-50/src/gov/__init__.py`. The commit author is shown as `Usain <usain@immortalcommunicate.com>`; that comes from the existing git configuration, which I did not change.
tests: none run (as the brief says); only the schema check of the frontmatter, which passed.
discoveries: The schema check needed jsonschema's older `RefResolver` because the `referencing` package is not installed; I installed nothing. Review 1's record gives `b7981b0f` as the probed commit, which is the CIT-E commit, not the implementation `91200c82`. §8 says this explicitly.
risks: DEC-752 is in `decisions_carried` but not yet in this worktree's register (staged for the owner's commit), just as DEC-751 already is. A check that requires carried decisions to be in the register would flag both until the owner commits them.
lessons: The `decisions_carried` key is not constrained by the shared frontmatter schema; validating the frontmatter here needs `RefResolver` with jsonschema 4.10.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: The further independent review under DEC-752 item 2 is still to be done. The two fail records stay as uncommitted drafts under `.gov-runtime/scratch/lead/probes/`.
recommended_next_action: Start the further independent review (DEC-752 item 2) at `d5abd786`; if it passes, commit only its pass record under `docs/probes/DAEO-kl5e/`.
